title: ManualSummaryToSlackWebhook
description: A slash command posted to summary-posted, decoded from its form body (application/x-www-form-urlencoded; if a key repeats, its last value wins) after the signature check over the raw body. Only /meetingsummary with non-blank text starts a manual job; any other command, or blank text, gets a private reply. Only the fields read are described; every other field is allowed and ignored.

text.description: Everything after the command: the pasted meeting summary. Never logged or stored.

channel_id.description: The channel the command was run in.

trigger_id.description: Unique per command run; part of the manual job ID.
